# SymbiYosys verification scope

- Source: YosysHQ, SymbiYosys documentation.
- URL: https://yosyshq.readthedocs.io/projects/sby/en/latest/index.html
- Accessed: 2026-07-10.

The documentation identifies SymbiYosys as a driver for Yosys-based formal flows. Its supported tasks include bounded and unbounded safety verification, cover-trace generation, and liveness verification. VeriSQL-HW’s supplied SBY files are safety/equivalence targets; they do not by themselves establish system liveness, transport correctness, or board-level timing.
